'''Gran Hans-Petter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Seattle tournament (16 September)]] on 16 September 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT]], according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1234">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-broken-games-seattle-wa-9-16-00d1234/ broken-games-seattle-wa-9-16-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 17 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-broken-games-seattle-wa-9-16-00d1234/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
